smoke_test_clarifications.smoke_sample_conclusion: Too small (n=8, 10 steps) to assess generation quality. Smoke test only verified execution, finite losses, and absence of NaN gradients.

pilot_assessment.collapse_notes: G_loss remained finite (2.74) at collapse onset; D_loss also finite (-1.66). Consistent with mode collapse to invalid graphs rather than numerical instability.
pilot_assessment.recommendation: Evaluate the pre-collapse checkpoint (step ~300, captured as generator_pilot.pt which is step 450 post-collapse) using independent predictors. The saved checkpoint is from after collapse. A mid-run checkpoint at step 300 was not saved. Options: (A) re-run pilot with checkpoint saving every 50 steps; (B) accept pilot as inconclusive for joint-threshold evaluation and diagnose collapse cause before further runs.
